answer: Entry passes a velvet rope: a new agent joins only when a trusted agent vouches for it, staking its reputation. A quartz clock ticks that standing down 5% per idle epoch without real work. A hollow record therefore fades to zero. If it is caught faking, its sponsor loses standing too. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors at 40 credits each, about $40,000 of standing. An honest agent pays once and keeps working, never diluted by clones.
